dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, no need, haha! I'll do it myself, but thanks for the offer. I wouldn't want to trouble you with a trifle like this.

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Me and Masa... Oh, I almost forgot, this Tatankasaurus here is Masa. We were supposed to deliver food, but a rampaging saurian careened into the warehouse, and, well...

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: What's done is done. It's no big deal, I'll have it tidied up in no time.
